title: Digital signature certificates (DSC)
summary: Each director obtains a digital signature certificate from a Certifying Authority licensed by the CCA, to sign the SPICe+ filing.

eligibility.text: In case number of subscribers and/or directors to eMoA and eAoA is up to twenty and all such subscribers and/or directors have DIN/PAN, it shall be mandatory for each one of them to obtain a DSC.

sources.title: How to get Digital Signature Certificate | CCA
FAQs on Incorporation and Allied Matters

steps.title: Get a digital signature certificate
steps.description: Approach any one of the Certifying Authorities licensed by the CCA (list on cca.gov.in). The DSC must then be registered on the MCA portal against the director's DIN or PAN.

fee.note: Set by each licensed Certifying Authority: the price of the certificate may vary from CA to CA.

review.note: Checked 2026-09-28, cca.gov.in: "One can approach any one of the Licensed CAs for getting a Digital Signature Certificate." CCA FAQ: "The price of the certificate may however vary from CA to CA."
